dateBootstrap.note: Exploratory date-cluster bootstrap; adjacent 12-month holdings overlap, so not a formal confidence interval.

portfolio.note: Integer one-copy purchases, $2000 per basket, at most 3 per set and 2 per character; uninvested cash earns nothing.

legacyReplay.note: Partial reconstruction. Matched rows are selected on future coverage, so no returns are compared.
